entities.summary: Burgundio of Pisa, sometimes erroneously styled "Burgundius", was a 12th-century Italian jurist. He was an ambassador for Pisa at Constantinople in 1136. He was a professor in Paris, and assisted at the Lateran Council in 1179, dying at a very advanced age in 1193.
